name: atlassian-twg-cli
description: Atlassian Teamwork Graph plugin marketplace for Claude Code.

plugins.name: atlassian-twg-cli
plugins.description:
Your code lives in your repo. The reasons behind it live in Jira work items, Confluence specs, PRs, Loom videos and Slack threads. Teamwork Graph CLI (twg) gives Claude Code one command-line interface to that context. Claude runs twg commands, gets structured JSON back, and pulls in only what the task needs. Commands use your Atlassian sign-in, so Claude can only access what you have permission to see. Run /twg-setup to get started.

How it works:
1. Install the plugin.
2. Run /twg-setup to install twg and sign in with your Atlassian account.
3. Ask in plain English. Claude picks the right twg command and runs it.

Try it:
- "Draft a Jira work item from this PR and link it to the epic"
- "Find the Confluence spec for this feature and check my branch against it"
- "What are my open Jira work items?"
- "Summarize the work I did this week"
- "Create a Bitbucket PR for my current branch"

Note: If you're using Claude Code in the browser, install the Atlassian Rovo MCP plugin instead.
